note: The state-machine driver snapshots the input-controlled glyph-info buffer pointer before processing an AAT morx subtable.
An insertion action can grow or move the buffer storage while the state-machine driver continues to use its earlier info pointer.
The driver should reload buffer->info after operations that can move the glyph-info array; instead it reads codepoint through the stale info pointer.
The stale or uninitialized glyph id is used as the format-0 lookup index, causing the target uninitialized-value read in the AAT lookup path.
